memories.content: Part-time advisor, spread across time zones. Has not yet responded to the poll from the CEO's assistant.

Ostara Foods has an advisory board of five part-time members spread across three time zones. The CEO's assistant has sent a poll with four candidate weekends for the autumn strategy offsite. Two advisors have already responded; three have not yet responded. The deadline for settling on a date is within three weeks from 2026-07-29, i.e., by 2026-08-19.
